title: OBDim NetworkSnapshot v1
description: OB Dim network snapshot contract v1 (frozen 2026-09-20, phase N0). Companion document: contracts/network/v1/README.md. Semantic rules S1-S8 that JSON Schema cannot express (id uniqueness, strictly increasing history timestamps, cross-field domain provenance, whole-message byte cap) are defined in README section 11 and enforced by tools/NetworkProbe validate.

schemaVersion.description: Contract version. Must match the /v1/ path.

origin.description: Production builds only accept 'host'. 'fixture' never appears in production.

captureStartedAt.description: Start of the current capture session (current snapshot epoch). Semantic rule S4: captureStartedAt <= asOf.

epoch.description: Capture-session epoch. Increments on capture restart; sequence resets to 0. Never compared across epochs.

sequence.description: Monotonic per snapshot epoch, starting at 0, +1 per snapshot.

coverage.description: Coverage state. Non-data states (stopped/starting/denied/disconnected) require empty apps/interfaces (semantic rule S5).

coverageReasons.description: Machine-readable coverage reason codes. Empty iff coverage=active (enforced by the if/then below and semantic rule S6).

block.description: Always false during the read-only phase (N2).

terminate.description: Always false during the read-only phase (N2).

capabilities.description: Real capability flags from the capture service. JSON booleans only; numbers/strings rejected.

droppedEvents.description: Raw events dropped in the current epoch due to aggregation/buffer pressure. Null = unknown; never encode unknown as 0.

truncated.description: True when any list/history was cut by the bounds in README section 9.

apps.description: App-scope observations. App ids must be unique (semantic rule S1). Never summed with interfaces.

interfaces.description: Interface-scope observations. Interface ids must be unique (semantic rule S1). Never summed with apps.

nullableCounter.description: Cumulative byte count in decimal bytes. Null = unknown; unknown is never encoded as 0.

nullableRate.description: Rate in decimal bytes/second (B/s). Null = unknown.

trafficPoint.description: One sample. up and down are independently nullable (N0 ruling, README section 7): a point may know one direction and not the other. History timestamps strictly increasing and <= asOf (semantic rule S3).

pid.description: OS process id. PIDs are reused; pid+startTime together identify a process instance.

id.description: Stable directional observation id, unique within the owning app (semantic rule S1). Not a display index.

direction.description: Direction of the counted bytes: up = local to remote, down = remote to local. NOT the TCP initiator identity.

initiator.description: Which side initiated the connection, separated from byte direction. unknown when there is no evidence.

hostname.description: Resolved hostname. Non-null requires domainSource system|proxy (semantic rule S2).

bytes.description: Observed bytes for this direction, not a packet count. Null = unknown.

domainSource.description: Provenance of the hostname. No evidence means unknown. proxyFlowId non-null requires proxy (semantic rule S2).

route.description: Display text; unknown must remain unknown.

proxyFlowId.description: Proxy (e.g. Mihomo) correlation id. Optional; only set with real correlation evidence, never guessed.

state.description: Free-form connection state (e.g. ESTABLISHED, TIME_WAIT, active).

id.description: Stable native app identity. Never a bare PID. Survives process restarts (app epoch increments instead).

bundleId.description: Bundle identifier (macOS). Usually null on Windows.

identitySource.description: How the app id was derived, e.g. executable-path, package-family, fallback-name.

uploadBytes.description: App-flow cumulative upload since captureStartedAt, valid only within the current app epoch.

downloadBytes.description: App-flow cumulative download since captureStartedAt, valid only within the current app epoch.

connectionCount.description: Observable connection count. Null = unknown (connection table unreadable); never report unknown as 0.

epoch.description: App cumulative-series epoch. Increments when a process restart resets the app's cumulative counters.

history.description: Strictly increasing timestamps (semantic rule S3); real gaps stay gaps, never zero-filled.

processes.description: (pid,startTime) pairs unique within this app (semantic rule S1).

id.description: Stable interface instance identity (e.g. Windows InterfaceGuid).

kind.description: unknown when classification evidence is insufficient.

rxBytes.description: Cumulative received bytes within the current interface epoch. Comparable only within the same epoch.

txBytes.description: Cumulative transmitted bytes within the current interface epoch. Comparable only within the same epoch.

epoch.description: Interface counter-series epoch. Increments on counter wrap or re-enumeration.
